annotations.title: Pin or color a Prism node

description: Sets pinned state and/or the color tag on a node. Pins are the cross-field shortlist. May return `needs_confirmation`.

color.description: Hex color, or null to clear.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
